# True Doors

> True Doors makes personalized door decals for care homes, with a focus on dementia-friendly environments, familiarity, individuality and feeling at home.

## Community stories

- [Community](https://www.truedoors.com/community): Published stories from care communities using True Doors.
- [Dignified dementia design](https://www.truedoors.com/community/true-doors-following-the-principles-of-dignified-dementia-design): A community story about dementia-design principles.
- [Pickering Manor](https://www.truedoors.com/community/pickering-manor-connects-memory-care-goals-and-design): A community story connecting memory-care goals and design.
- [Rembrandt Living](https://www.truedoors.com/community/gezellig-truedoors-rembrandt-living-south-australia): A community story from South Australia.

## Products and practical information

- [True Doors](https://www.truedoors.com/): Brand and product overview.
- [Door collection](https://my.truedoors.com/collection/): Browse door decal designs.
- [How-to guides](https://www.truedoors.com/how-to): Measuring, installation, care and removal.
- [About True Doors](https://www.truedoors.com/about): Organization information.
- [Contact](https://www.truedoors.com/contact): Inquiries and support.

## Source context

Community stories describe individual experiences, not clinical evidence or guaranteed outcomes. Consult the linked source for authorship, publication date, image credits and the full context of a quotation. A story's organization profile identifies the participating organization; it is not medical advice.

Only published public URLs are listed here. Preview pages, private CRM records and unpublished HubDB data are not sources. This file is a curated discovery aid, not a replacement for the sitemap, robots.txt, access controls or page-level indexing directives. It does not guarantee inclusion in any model or search index.
